rule: SUPPORTED iff r_DE >= 1.5 AND r_JP >= 1.5 AND r_DE > r_US(2000 cut) AND r_JP > r_US(2012 cut), where r_market = rate(old-source era) / rate(modern era) and r_US uses the same cut dates as placebo boundaries on the US pair. INVERTED recorded additionally iff both r_DE and r_JP <= 1/1.5. Anything else: NOT SUPPORTED.
